# Sefarim Source/Test Verification

The Awtsmoos lets every contract find its living owner and every owner return its truthful light;
Awtsmoos.com now carries the reconstructed search vessel through a complete green source-test night.

## Planned

Close stale presentation, mode-intent, shared source-action, and bounded-search harness contracts without changing healthy production behavior merely to satisfy obsolete tests.

## Actual

- `searchFoldContract.test.mjs` follows `SearchApp`, `SearchControlDisclosure`, form/disclosure CSS, active-search CSS, and mobile context owners. It is 72 lines and passes 6/6 focused assertions.
- `searchMode.test.mjs` preserves deliberate Library default for Hebrew and English, explicit mode hydration, Tanach API exact search, and shared safe source-action delegation. It is 49 lines and passes 3/3 focused assertions.
- `searchApiBoundedComments.test.mjs` now exercises `searchLibraryRequest.js` and `apiTransport.js` directly and verifies `searchApi.js` composition without a broken data-URL harness. It is 63 lines and passes 3/3 focused assertions.
- Complete Sefarim `*.test.mjs` suite passes 15/15 with zero failures.
- Production `searchApi.js`, `SearchApp.js`, `SearchControlDisclosure.js`, `resultSourceActions.js`, request builder, transport, and telemetry modules were preserved when traces proved their current behavior correct.

## Remaining Performance Observation

Node reports `MODULE_TYPELESS_PACKAGE_JSON` reparsing warnings for browser ESM `.js` modules because the repository root package does not declare `type: module`. This incurs test-runner parsing overhead. It is not changed here because root package semantics have a repository-wide blast radius and require separate evidence.

## DELTA

No remaining known Sefarim source/test failure. Browser geometry, interaction, runtime-network, and performance verification remain open.

## NEXT_ACTION

Open the real public Sefarim route in Chrome, test responsive/interactions/errors, collect timings/resources, then update the route ledger and advance to the sitewide matrix.
